# Filevora

Navigation index for coding agents. This is not a capability claim. Trust `docs/agents/capabilities.json` and the tests.

- [README](README.md)
- [Install](docs/agents/install.md)
- [Decision guide](docs/agents/decision-guide.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/agents/troubleshooting.md)
- [Verification](docs/agents/verification.md)
- [Capabilities](docs/agents/capabilities.json)
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) — no `FILEVORA_DATABASE_URL` is lite mode; a URL selects stored mode. Schemes: `postgres://`, `postgresql://`, `mysql://`, `mariadb://`, `sqlite://` or a file path. Migrate creates only `filevora_assets` and `filevora_asset_versions`. `POST /assets/from-url` imports an http(s) URL. The SDK sniffs the bytes and blocks private and metadata addresses.
- [Transform](docs/agents/transform.md) — `POST /files/:assetId/transform` with one config object. `replace` defaults to true. Progress events share `phase`, `percentage`, `etaMs`, and a terminal `versions` list.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Security](docs/security.md)

- [Agents](AGENTS.md)
